context:
Goal: batches never wait for a macOS runner.
Problem (risk): your MacBook adds macOS capacity, but it would run code from a public repo.
Based on (measured): batch 103 waited 26.4 min for macOS; GitHub Free allows 5 macOS jobs at once (GitHub Actions limits page). Degen's CLAUDE.md lists the runner degen-mac as opt-in until it has a green run.
Departs from: main runs only on GitHub-hosted runners — your Mac takes the batch macOS jobs.
home: step ci-macos-queue (batches stop waiting for macOS)

lastAnswer.note: Owner 14:19 CST: "agreed on e, my mac isn't available all the time but imjust saying it shd be available rn and it can help". Runner label claude-settings-mac; GitHub macOS fallback; never a fork PR (R58).

options.gain: Batches get their own macOS machine.
options.how: Your Mac runs batch macOS jobs only, never a fork PR, with GitHub macOS as the fallback when it is offline; drafts follow your pick on the draft item. Say in the note which repo your MacBook runner is registered to.
options.label: Mac runs batch jobs only (Recommended)
options.lose: Setup work; your Mac is busy during batch runs and runs this repo's code.

options.how: Only the draft change, and a request to GitHub Support for more macOS slots.
options.label: Ask GitHub for more slots
options.lose: Depends on GitHub; batches still share 5 slots with degen.

title: Your MacBook runs batch macOS jobs, beside the draft change
why: It runs this repo's code on your own Mac.
